column1: # Seeed reTerminal Sticky -- partition table
# Every other board uses a single "factory" app partition
# (partitions.csv / partitions_8mb.csv). This board instead uses the
# standard ESP-IDF dual-OTA layout: an "otadata" partition plus two
# app slots (ota_0 / ota_1). Draftling runs from ota_0; ota_1 is left
# empty.
# Why this board is different: like the Xteink X4 Pro / Classic (see
# partitions_xteink_x4_pro.csv)
column2: this board also runs the third-party
